<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' targetDocType='CernAdtHl7:CernerInAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Translates UofU Adt Hl7 records to Cerner specific</annotation> <if condition='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent} = "A04"' > <true> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"UOFU_ADT"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.empiNumber' property='target.{PID:PatientID.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientIdentifierList()}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList()}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().familyname.surname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName().givenname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().givenname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' property='target.{PID:PatientName().secondandfurthergivennamesor}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:SSNNumberPatient}' property='target.{PID:SSNNumberPatient}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAddress()}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress()}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome()}' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome()}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness()}' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness()}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' property='target.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth}' property='target.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='"UOFU_ADT"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.empiNumber' property='target.{PID:PatientID.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}' property='target.{PV1:VisitNumber.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1:AlternateVisitID.ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientAccountNumber.ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PV1:VisitNumber.ID}' property='target.{PV1:AlternateVisitID.ID}' action='set' /> </false> </if>
<foreach property='source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome()}' key='k1' > <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationequipmentty} = "PH")' > <true> <assign value='"193"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationequipmentty} = "CP")' > <true> <assign value='"195"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationusecode} = "NET")' > <true> <assign value='"50450664"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </foreach>
<foreach property='source.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness()}' key='k1' > <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationequipmentty} = "WK")' > <true> <assign value='"194"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationequipmentty} = "CP")' > <true> <assign value='"195"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='(source.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationusecode} = "NET")' > <true> <assign value='"50450665"' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberBusiness(k1).telecommunicationusecode}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </foreach>
</transform>
